title: Real-name verification
description: Enter your legal name and school for administrator review. You can continue using the site for seven days after your first submission.
exemptDescription: Super administrators and judge service accounts do not need to submit real-name verification.
rejectedDescription: Review your information and submit it again.

validation.realNameMin: Legal name must be at least 2 characters
validation.schoolMin: School name must be at least 2 characters

form.title: Verification information
form.description: Use your legal name and the full official name of your school.
form.schoolHelp: Enter the full official school name, 2–128 characters.
form.submitFailed: Submission failed. Please try again later.

grace.title: Seven-day grace period
grace.until: You can continue using the site until {deadline}.
grace.pendingExpired: Other site features are unavailable until an administrator approves your application.
grace.rejectedExpired: Resubmit your application. Other site features remain unavailable until it is approved.

help.title: Review process
help.review: You can continue using the site for seven days after your first submission while an administrator reviews it.
help.update: You can update a pending application, but doing so does not restart the grace period.
help.resubmit: A rejected application can be corrected and submitted again.

status.noneTitle: Real-name verification has not been submitted
status.approvedDescription: You can now use all site features normally.

reminder.pendingDescription: You can continue using the site until {deadline}.

manage.title: Real-name review
manage.emptyDescription: No real-name applications match the current filter.
manage.actionFailed: The review action failed. Please try again later.

dialog.approveDescription: Approving {name}'s verification grants the user full site access.
dialog.rejectDescription: After rejecting {name}'s application, the user can correct and resubmit it.
dialog.revokeDescription: If the grace period has ended, revoking {name}'s verification immediately removes access to other site features.
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: Enter a reason to show the user
